basic_info.description: Discover your dream home in the heart of San Francisco! This charming 3-bedroom, 2-1/2 bathroom property offers a perfect blend of coastal living and city convenience, located just minutes from Ocean Beach and Golden Gate Park. ✨ Key Features include a spacious Layout with abundant natural light, hardwood floors throughout the main areas private backyard - ideal for relaxing, gardening, or entertaining, garage & driveway parking with storage space and a bonus room that can serve as a home office, guest space, or gym. 🌊 Prime Location! Just steps from the beach for weekend strolls and surfing. Close to restaurants, coffee shops, and local markets. Convenient access to public transportation and major highways. Whether you're looking for a cozy family home or a rental investment, 1471 43rd Ave is your chance to own a piece of San Francisco's vibrant lifestyle.
